Proposition
[Positive AVR from quadratic curvature decay] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0108 ↗ def:chow-iii-asymptotic-ratios ↗ def:chow-iii-kappa-noncollapsed 1. ch19:19.19\group Asymptotic Geometry

If $\Rm \ge 0$, the metric is $\kappa $-noncollapsed at all scales, and $|\Rm |(x)\le Cd(x,O)^{-2}$ outside $B(O,1)$, then \[ \operatorname {AVR}(h)\ge \frac{\kappa }{2^nC^{n/2}\omega _n}>0. \] Consequently, an all-scale $\kappa $-noncollapsed metric with $\operatorname {AVR}=0$ has $\operatorname {ASCR}=\infty $.
